title: R1 ecology constitution re-instantiated in the ACE free zone
purpose: Preserve the design logic that made R1 an exploratory ecology, without reviving its historical daemons, personas, external senders, or automatic recommendation paths.

invariants.name: continuity_over_cleverness
invariants.rule: A replaceable worker, model, or runtime must not erase the route, evidence, or memory that lets the next one continue.

invariants.name: freedom_inside_boundary
invariants.rule: The free zone may explore conflicting or unfashionable hypotheses, but its outward edge is proposal-only and cannot alter production.

invariants.name: failure_is_material
invariants.rule: Failures, dead ends, and contradictions are retained as searchable counterexamples rather than hidden to make reports look successful.

invariants.name: compression_not_copying
invariants.rule: Distill experience into portable principles and seeds; do not copy historical implementation details as if they were the constitution.

invariants.name: roles_are_niches
invariants.rule: Explorer, curator, court, teacher, and production runtime have different permissions; no role silently inherits another role's authority.

invariants.name: no_activity_quota
invariants.rule: A quiet observation window is valid when no evidence-backed work exists; activity must not be manufactured to prove that the system is alive.

may_not: turn invalid evidence into a fact
bypass Data Health, Validator, Risk, or Admission

reinstantiation_mapping.R1_MengPo_decay: quarantine plus explicit stale/pollution flags; no destructive deletion
reinstantiation_mapping.R1_marking_factory: inventory status, disposition, hashes, and evidence strength
reinstantiation_mapping.R1_courier: local/Git evidence references carried into a proposal, never credentials
reinstantiation_mapping.R1_multi_worlds: one bounded hypothesis at a time; competing hypotheses remain separate experiments
reinstantiation_mapping.R2_boundary: sandbox manifest and one-way proposal boundary
reinstantiation_mapping.R2_continuity: append-only experiment records, hashes, reports, and state
reinstantiation_mapping.R2_observation: daily museum inventory and explicit NO_NEW_MUSEUM_WORK

forbidden_revivers: old daily_self_loop.py as a second scheduler
old heartbeat.py as a second daemon
autonomous_loop.py process spawning or dependency installation
historical persona or model claims treated as current evidence
